title: Dasakam 50 — Vatsāsura-Bakāsurayor Vadha
description: Krishna tends calves in Vrindavan, overcomes Vatsasura and Bakasura, and returns among the cowherd community.
translation_note: No vetted English translation is supplied. Facebook picture captions are preserved verbatim as commentary at their own #N keys (intake/D050/photo-captions.txt); they are not translations. S5 and S10 have no picture or caption in the post, so they have no commentary. Canonical Sanskrit and IAST are transcribed from Stotra Nidhi.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तरलमधुकृद्बृन्दे बृन्दावनेऽथ मनोहरे
पशुपशिशुभिः साकं वत्सानुपालनलोलुपः ।
हलधरसखो देव श्रीमन् विचेरिथ धारयन्
गवलमुरलीवेत्रं नेत्राभिरामतनुद्युतिः ॥ ५०-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
taralamadhukṛdbṛnde bṛndāvane’tha manohare
paśupaśiśubhiḥ sākaṃ vatsānupālanalolupaḥ |
haladharasakho deva śrīman viceritha dhārayan
gavalamuralīvetraṃ netrābhirāmatanudyutiḥ || 50-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: In the beautiful Brindaavana, with swarms of honey bees going around, Krishna Bhagwan carried horn, flute and a cute stick, along with Balarama and other cowherd boys left to the forest with cows and calves.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विहितजगतीरक्षं लक्ष्मीकराम्बुजलालितं
ददति चरणद्वन्द्वं बृन्दावने त्वयि पावने ।
किमिव न बभौ सम्पत्सम्पूरितं तरुवल्लरी-
-सलिलधरणीगोत्रक्षेत्रादिकं कमलापते ॥ ५०-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vihitajagatīrakṣaṃ lakṣmīkarāmbujalālitaṃ
dadati caraṇadvandvaṃ bṛndāvane tvayi pāvane |
kimiva na babhau sampatsampūritaṃ taruvallarī-
-saliladharaṇīgotrakṣetrādikaṃ kamalāpate || 50-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: When Bhagwan’s lotus feet which is caressed by the lotus hands of Goddess Sri Lakshmi, touched Brindavana, all the trees, plants, creepers, water, earth, mountain and fields bloomed with prosperity.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विलसदुलपे कान्तारान्ते समीरणशीतले
विपुलयमुनातीरे गोवर्धनाचलमूर्धसु ।
ललितमुरलीनादः सञ्चारयन् खलु वात्सकं
क्वचन दिवसे दैत्यं वत्साकृतिं त्वमुदैक्षथाः ॥ ५०-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vilasadulape kāntārānte samīraṇaśītale
vipulayamunātīre govardhanācalamūrdhasu |
lalitamuralīnādaḥ sañcārayan khalu vātsakaṃ
kvacana divase daityaṃ vatsākṛtiṃ tvamudaikṣathāḥ || 50-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: One day, Krishna was playing his flute gently enjoying the cool breeze from Govardhana Mountain, and taking care of calves which were grazing in the meadows. Krishna saw Vatsasura who came in the form of a calf.

stanzas.sanskrit:
रभसविलसत्पुच्छं विच्छायतोऽस्य विलोकयन्
किमपि वलितस्कन्धं रन्ध्रप्रतीक्षमुदीक्षितम् ।
तमथ चरणे बिभ्रद्विभ्रामयन् मुहुरुच्चकैः
कुहचन महावृक्षे चिक्षेपिथ क्षतजीवितम् ॥ ५०-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
rabhasavilasatpucchaṃ vicchāyato’sya vilokayan
kimapi valitaskandhaṃ randhrapratīkṣamudīkṣitam |
tamatha caraṇe bibhradvibhrāmayan muhuruccakaiḥ
kuhacan mahāvṛkṣe cikṣepitha kṣatajīvitam || 50-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: As the Asura walked about, wagging its tail briskly and forcefully, it turned its head in a strange way looking for a chance to strike. Krishna caught him by his two legs and swirling him very fast again and again, threw him on a big tree and lost his life.

stanzas.sanskrit:
निपतति महादैत्ये जात्या दुरात्मनि तत् क्षणं
निपतनजवक्षुण्णक्षोणीरुहक्षतकानने ।
दिवि परमिलद्बृन्दा बृन्दारकाः कुसुमोत्करैः
शिरसि भवतो हर्षाद्वर्षन्ति नाम तदा हरे ॥ ५०-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nipatati mahādaitye jātyā durātmani tat kṣaṇaṃ
nipatanajavakṣuṇṇakṣoṇīruhakṣatakānane |
divi paramiladbṛndā bṛndārakāḥ kusumotkaraiḥ
śirasi bhavato harṣādvarṣanti nāma tadā hare || 50-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सुरभिलतमामूर्धन्यूर्ध्वं कुतः कुसुमावली
निपतति तवेत्युक्तो बालैः सहेलमुदैरयः ।
झटिति दनुजक्षेपेणोर्ध्वं गतस्तरुमण्डलात्
कुसुमनिकरः सोऽयं नूनं समेति शनैरिति ॥ ५०-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
surabhilatamāmūrdhanyūrdhvaṃ kutaḥ kusumāvalī
nipatati tavetyukto bālaiḥ sahelamudairayaḥ |
jhaṭiti danujakṣepeṇordhvaṃ gatastarumaṇḍalāt
kusumanikaraḥ so’yaṃ nūnaṃ sameti śanairiti || 50-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The innocent Gopas wondered and asked from where flowers fell on Krishna's head. Krishna jokingly replied that when asura was attacked, due to impact of hitting the asura on the tree, the bloomed flowers of the trees came down.

stanzas.sanskrit:
क्वचन दिवसे भूयो भूयस्तरे परुषातपे
तपनतनयापाथः पातुं गता भवदादयः ।
चलितगरुतं प्रेक्षामासुर्बकं खलु विस्मृतं
क्षितिधरगरुच्छेदे कैलासशैलमिवापरम् ॥ ५०-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kvacana divase bhūyo bhūyastare paruṣātape
tapanatanayāpāthaḥ pātuṃ gatā bhavadādayaḥ |
calitagarutaṃ prekṣāmāsurbakaṃ khalu vismṛtaṃ
kṣitidharagarucchede kailāsaśailamivāparam || 50-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Again on another hot day, Bhagwan and others went to drink the water of river Yamunaa. Bhagwan saw a crane flapping its wings very quickly, which looked like the mountain Kailaash.

stanzas.sanskrit:
पिबति सलिलं गोपव्राते भवन्तमभिद्रुतः
स किल निगिलन्नग्निप्रख्यं पुनर्द्रुतमुद्वमन् ।
दलयितुमगात् त्रोट्याः कोट्या तदा तु भवान् विभो
खलजनभिदाचुञ्चुश्चञ्चू प्रगृह्य ददार तम् ॥ ५०-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pibati salilaṃ gopavrāte bhavantamabhidrutaḥ
sa kila nigilannagniprakhyaṃ punardrutamudvaman |
dalayitumagāt troṭyāḥ koṭyā tadā tu bhavān vibho
khalajanabhidācuñcuścañcū pragṛhya dadāra tam || 50-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: When the cowherd boys were drinking water, Bakasura in the disguise of crane charged towards Krishna, swallowed and again hastily spit Krishna out like a ball of fire. He then came to tear Krishna by the point of its beak. But Bhagwan catching hold of his beak, tore him apart.

stanzas.sanskrit:
सपदि सहजां सन्द्रष्टुं वा मृतां खलु पूतना-
-मनुजमघमप्यग्रे गत्वा प्रतीक्षितुमेव वा ।
शमननिलयं याते तस्मिन् बके सुमनोगणे
किरति सुमनोबृन्दं बृन्दावनाद्गृहमैयथाः ॥ ५०-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sapadi sahajāṃ sandraṣṭuṃ vā mṛtāṃ khalu pūtanā-
-manujamaghamapyagre gatvā pratīkṣitumeva vā |
śamananilayaṃ yāte tasmin bake sumanogaṇe
kirati sumanobṛndaṃ bṛndāvanādgṛhamaiyathāḥ || 50-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bakasura died so quickly as if in a hurry to see his sister Putana who went before him or to welcome his younger brother Agasura who is going to follow him soon. Devas showered flowers from heaven. Krishna returned home along with cowherd boys from the Brindavana.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ललितमुरलीनादं दूरान्निशम्य वधूजनै-
-स्त्वरितमुपगम्यारादारूढमोदमुदीक्षितः ।
जनितजननीनन्दानन्दः समीरणमन्दिर-
-प्रथितवसते शौरे दूरीकुरुष्व ममामयान् ॥ ५०-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
lalitamuralīnādaṃ dūrānniśamya vadhūjanai-
-stvaritamupagamyārādārūḍhamodamudīkṣitaḥ |
janitajananīnandānandaḥ samīraṇamandira-
-prathitavasate śaure dūrīkuruṣva mamāmayān || 50-10 ||
